name: FFB
recent: Farm Fresh 最近出现董事与委员会人事变动，Dato' Ismail Bin Karim 辞任审计、提名与薪酬委员会及董事会职务。同时，公司发布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。此外，雇员公积金局（EPF）与退休基金局（KWAP）在10月至11月间多次申报股权变动。
notable: Dato' Ismail Bin Karim 辞去董事会及审计、提名与薪酬委员会职务。
公司发布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。
EPF 与 KWAP 在10月至11月间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 董事及主要股东在10月有多笔股份交易申报。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为3.0637亿令吉，环比增长11.4%，同比增长17.6%；净利为2682万令吉，环比下降3.9%，同比下降18.2%；净利率为8.8%，低于上一季度的10.1%。

recent_en: Farm Fresh recently saw board and committee changes, with Dato' Ismail Bin Karim leaving the audit, nomination and remuneration committees and the board. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. In addition, EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November.
notable_en: Dato' Ismail Bin Karim left the board and the audit, nomination and remuneration committees.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November.
risks_en: There were multiple share dealing disclosures by directors and a substantial shareholder in October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR306.37 million, up 11.4% QoQ and 17.6% YoY; net income was MYR26.82 million, down 3.9% QoQ and 18.2% YoY; net margin was 8.8%, lower than 10.1% in the previous quarter.
